list.name: Scraper failures
list.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       COALESCE(finished_at, started_at + INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS time_end,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(left(error, 160), ''), 'run failed') AS text
FROM lean.scrape_runs
WHERE status = 'error'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event timestamps rather than reconstructed daily inventory.

panels.title: Active listings
panels.description: Uses current listing state, observed timestamps, or recorded price changes from lean tables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal:sqlstring} = 'All' OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal:sqlstring} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal:sqlstring} END) AND (${rooms:sqlstring} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms:sqlstring}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (${category:sqlstring} = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lean.saved_searches ss WHERE ss.search_key = ANY(l.search_keys) AND ss.category = ${category:sqlstring})) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm:sqlstring}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm:sqlstring}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm:sqlstring}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm:sqlstring}, '')::numeric)) SELECT count(*) AS active,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7) AS new_7d,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0)::numeric,0) AS median_sale_ppm2,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE deal='rent' AND price>0)::numeric,0) AS median_rent
FROM base

panels.title: Median reported sale price KM/m² by day
panels.description: Daily median across sale listings active at day end. Each listing carries forward its latest detail-reported price; historical KM/m² uses current area.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 89) AS start_day,
         LEAST(date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS end_day
), openings AS (
  SELECT article_id, first_seen AS opened_at FROM lean.listings
  UNION ALL
  SELECT article_id, occurred_at AS opened_at FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events WHERE event_type = 'reopened'
), cycles AS (
  SELECT o.article_id, o.opened_at, c.closed_at
  FROM openings o
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT min(e.occurred_at) AS closed_at
    FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
    WHERE e.article_id = o.article_id AND e.event_type = 'closed' AND e.occurred_at > o.opened_at
  ) c ON TRUE
), price_spans AS (
  SELECT ph.article_id, ph.price, ph.price_date,
         lead(ph.price_date) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.article_id ORDER BY ph.price_date) AS next_date
  FROM lean.price_history ph
  WHERE ph.source = 'api_price_history' AND ph.price > 0
), daily AS (
  SELECT d.day::date AS day, p.price / NULLIF(l.sqm, 0) AS ppm2
  FROM price_spans p
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    GREATEST(p.price_date, b.start_day),
    LEAST(COALESCE(p.next_date - 1, b.end_day), b.end_day),
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS d(day) ON TRUE
  JOIN cycles c ON c.article_id = p.article_id AND c.opened_at < d.day::date + 1 AND (c.closed_at IS NULL OR c.closed_at >= d.day::date + 1)
  JOIN lean.listings l ON l.article_id = c.article_id AND l.deal = 'sale' AND l.sqm > 0
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS p25,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS median,
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS p75,
       count(*) AS listings
FROM daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date($__timeFrom() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), date($__timeTo() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS day), movements AS (SELECT first_seen AS day, 1 AS new_n, 0 AS closed_n FROM lean.listings UNION ALL SELECT closed_at, 0, 1 FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time, COALESCE(sum(m.new_n),0)::int AS new_n, COALESCE(sum(m.closed_n),0)::int AS closed_n FROM days d LEFT JOIN movements m USING(day) GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day
